body:
## Problem

`packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `daniel-erlandsson` entry, `setup.drums` block (lines 13-23):
```
drums: {
  item: 'Pearl Masters Premium',
  model: '6-piece maple shell pack',
  ...
  year: 2001,
  source: 'Pearl Masters Premium catalog MSRP 2001',
  notes: "Pearl Masters Premium maple shells delivered balanced projection ... Arch Enemy's dual-guitar harmonic layers ...",
  ...
},
```
Issue #7278 already fixed this same drummer's `priceEvolution` entry (changed a wrongly-dated 2011 "transitions to Pearl Reference Pure" row to 2002, since corrected to 2001 by #8593) plus the cymbals/sticks fields in this file — but never touched this `setup.drums` block, which still states the earlier "Pearl Masters Premium" model for the same 2001 Wages of Sin era that the (now-fixed) `priceEvolution` array says had already reached Pearl Reference Pure.

## Verified (internal source of truth)

`packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js`, `daniel-erlandsson` timeline (~line 2589-2592):
```
{
  year: 2001,
  changeType: ENDORSEMENT_CHANGE_TYPES.SIGNED,
  category: ENDORSEMENT_CATEGORIES.DRUMS,
  from: 'Pearl Masters',
  to: 'Pearl Reference Pure',
  notes: "Reached his fully documented Pearl Reference Pure configuration on Wages of Sin (2001), paired with a Pearl Free-Floating Brass 14\"x6.5\" snare",
},
```
By 2001 (Wages of Sin), the verified configuration is Pearl Reference Pure, not Pearl Masters Premium — the `setup.drums` block is describing the pre-2001 kit as if it were the Wages of Sin-era kit itself.

## Fix

In `packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `daniel-erlandsson` `setup.drums` block: change `item` from `'Pearl Masters Premium'` to `'Pearl Reference Pure'` (or equivalent model name), update `source`/`notes` to reflect the Wages of Sin (2001) Reference Pure configuration instead of the earlier Masters-era kit. Do not touch cymbals/sticks/priceEvolution fields — already fixed by #7278/#8593.

## Verify
- [ ] `grep -n "Pearl Masters Premium" packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js` within the daniel-erlandsson block returns zero hits
- [ ] `setup.drums.item` matches `endorsementNews.js`'s verified 2001 Pearl Reference Pure configuration
- [ ] `setup.drums` no longer contradicts the already-corrected `priceEvolution` array in the same entry
- [ ] Cymbals/sticks fields (already fixed by #7278) left untouched

## Done
`gearPriceHistory.js`'s `daniel-erlandsson` `setup.drums` block matches `endorsementNews.js`'s verified 2001 Pearl Reference Pure configuration and no longer self-contradicts the entry's own `priceEvolution` array; zero new pages/URLs.
title: SEO: Daniel Erlandsson gearPriceHistory.js setup.drums still says 'Pearl Masters Premium' at 2001 — same album's own Reference Pure switch already fixed elsewhere in the file
